def test_soft_wrap_background_color():
    console = Console()

    output = StringIO()

    console.print("correctly has no color from previous line")
    sys.stdout = sys.__stdout__
    
    # Check the output

    assert '\x1b[48;' not in printed_output[1]  # Check if background color is absent
